name: g1
_note: G1 deterministic stand + TABLE MANIPULATION. Derived from g1_armsdown.json: the lower-body stand (stiff squat + lean + hip auto_trim) is UNCHANGED and load-bearing. The NEW 'manip' block reaches with ONE arm (right) via position-only IK to pick/lift/move/place cubes off a table while the OTHER arm (left) keeps arm_balance running as the fast balancer. Fingerless rubber hand -> kinematic WELD grasp (magnet attach), NOT a physical fingered grasp. All waypoints are IK-verified reachable (<=1mm) for the right 5-DOF arm with the chain below.
_nominal_note: NATURAL arms-hanging-down rest pose (shoulder_pitch=0.95, elbow=0.45, slight shoulder_roll out): each arm hangs down beside the body (hand ~x=-0.12, below the shoulder) -- the natural rest for this arm. NOT the old shoulder_pitch=1.5708 which (per FK) points the arms BACKWARD-and-UP (hand x=-0.29, shoulder height) and looks unnatural. CoM is close to that old pose so the stand stays stable. shoulder_roll mirrors L(+)/R(-) to keep each elbow slightly outboard.

lean._note: Disturbance-driven (vx, pitch_rate); ~0 during a slow feedforward reach so it does NOT fight the manipulation trajectory, but it still catches thrown cubes. Keep ON.

arm_balance._note: P balancer on the shoulders (proven cube-defense gains). When manip is active the controller filters this to the BALANCE arm only (left); on DONE both arms balance again. It now swings around the NATURAL arms-down nominal, so the balance motion reads as a person steadying themselves rather than a contortion.

auto_trim._note: HIP-ONLY return-to-home; the slow high-authority effector that absorbs the forward CoM creep from the extended reaching arm.

manip._note: Deterministic table manipulation overlay. State machine per cube: REACH_ABOVE -> DESCEND -> GRASP(weld) -> LIFT -> MOVE -> PLACE -> RELEASE -> RETRACT, then next cube. TCP targets are world coords; IK solves the 5 reach-arm joints. Cube live position is read each REACH_ABOVE. Carry = teleport cube to the hand link world pose + setVelocity([0]*6) every tick (warm-solver bounce fix). All waypoints IK-verified <=1mm.
manip._posture_note: Null-space posture bias keeps the redundant arm DOF (the 5-DOF arm has 2 redundant DOF for a 3-DOF position) at a NATURAL, body-clear config: elbow abducted OUT (shoulder_roll ~-0.30), wrist + shoulder_yaw ~0. Without it the position-only IK contorts the arm THROUGH the torso. Verified: elbow stays outboard (y<=-0.18, never inside the torso) through every waypoint, pos err <=~10mm.
manip._chain_note: Per-joint URDF tuple [origin_x,y,z, rpy_r,p,y, axis_x,y,z] relative to torso_link, extracted from g1_23dof_omnisim.urdf (shoulder_pitch/roll/yaw, elbow, wrist_roll). The right chain mirrors the left in y. If the URDF arm changes, re-extract.
